RDS PostgreSQL

descriptions.en:
### Applicable DPI engine
RDS PostgreSQL

### Related feature documentation
><warning>This API operation incurs fees. Read the related feature documentation carefully before you perform this operation.></warning>
[RDS Supabase](~~2938735~~)

><notice>Deleting an RDS Supabase project does not automatically delete the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance or the Internet NAT gateway that were created with the project. You must [manual release the instance](~~96749~~) and delete the [Internet NAT gateway](~~121139~~) and [EIP](~~121527~~).></notice>
